## Summary

Describe the automation or documentation change and the business problem it addresses.

## Validation

- [ ] `git diff --check` passes.
- [ ] Relevant project tests or manual validation were completed.
- [ ] README, architecture, or demo evidence was updated where needed.

## Portfolio safety

- [ ] No secrets, credential exports, real customer data, or private screenshots are included.
- [ ] Workflow exports are safe to publish and do not contain embedded credentials.
- [ ] Status and outcome claims distinguish planned work from verified results.
